title: Waverly Place Double Glass Shelf With Gallery Rail, 16-Inch Wall Mount, Solid Brass Hardware, Allied Brass
body_html:
Clear the counter and keep everyday essentials neatly in reach with this 16-inch double glass shelf. Backed by a lifetime warranty, it combines 3/8-inch tempered glass with solid brass hardware for enduring bathroom organization.

  • Adds two levels of storage for toiletries without taking up vanity space
  • Keeps bottles and grooming items from sliding with the built-in gallery rail
  • Creates a clean, finished look with concealed screw mounting
  • Holds up to 4 lb for dependable, everyday bathroom use
  • Solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives

Part of the Waverly Place collection—complete your bathroom with matching pieces for a coordinated look.

Specs

  • Product type: Double glass bathroom shelf with gallery rail
  • Mounting: Wall mount; concealed screw mounting
  • Glass: 3/8-in (0.38 in) tempered glass
  • Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 inches
  • Overall dimensions: 16 in L x 5 in projection x 8 in H
  • Weight capacity: 4 lb
  • Material: Brass hardware
  • Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4
  • Warranty: Lifetime warranty
meta_description: 16-inch double glass shelf with gallery rail for bathroom storage. Wall mount with 3/8-in tempered glass and solid brass hardware, lifetime warranty.
